name: codebase-kg
description: Builds, maintains, and serves a per-repo code graph — a committed SQLite map of any codebase (nodes = components, symbol anchors = where they live, edges = relationships) so an agent can orient and find code without re-deriving the map every session. Constant-time load and indexed full-text search at any size; dangling edges and inconsistent data are impossible to write, not merely reported. Language-agnostic. Cross-codebase parity linking tracks feature gaps between paired repos (e.g. an iOS app and its Android port). A search gate points the agent at the graph before it greps; the commit check advises, and the push check blocks only on stale mapped files.

server_port.title: Server port
server_port.description: Loopback port of the shared codebase-kg HTTP server. Change it only when another program uses 47821.

max_workers.title: Maximum workers
max_workers.description: Most worker processes the server runs tool calls on at once, with no upper limit. 0 runs every call in the server process. A running server keeps the value it started with: to apply a change, run "mcp/launch/kg_cli.py server stop" from the plugin folder, then restart Claude Code. See the README, section Changing max_workers.
